name: shoot-week
title: The shoot week
subtitle: Demo production office. Times use one production-office clock.

sections.title: Next seven days
sections.sql: select ref,production,shoot_date,unit,location,scenes,planned_minutes,confirmed_people from v_schedule where shoot_date between current_date and current_date+7 order by shoot_date,ref

sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by priority,category,ref

sections.title: Progress
sections.sql: select ref,name,shot,scenes,unscheduled,missed from v_progress order by ref

sections.title: Missing cast coverage
sections.sql: select shoot_day,scene,person,character_name,booking_status from v_cast_gaps order by shoot_date,scene

sections.title: Clashing bookings
sections.sql: select person,first_day,second_day,shoot_date from v_conflicts order by shoot_date

sections.title: Location clashes
sections.sql: select * from v_location_conflicts order by shoot_date

name: working-hours
title: Working-hours review
subtitle: Recorded wall-clock minutes only. This is not payroll.

sections.title: Working hours
sections.sql: select ref,production,person,work_date,status,worked_minutes,flag from v_hours order by work_date,person

sections.title: Rest policy flags
sections.note: The demo policy asks for 720 minutes between recorded shifts. Set your agreed production policy. This is not a statutory threshold.
sections.sql: select * from v_rest_gaps order by work_date,person

sections.title: Safety record checks
sections.sql: select shoot_day,rule,issue from v_compliance order by shoot_date,shoot_day
